meta.title: GeneBridge: understand your genetic risks
meta.description: A privacy-first platform that helps individuals and couples understand inherited disease risks, explore their options, and connect with qualified genetic counsellors.

hero.title: Understand your genetic risks. Make informed reproductive decisions.
hero.subtitle: A privacy-first platform that helps individuals and couples understand inherited disease risks, explore their options, and connect with qualified genetic counsellors.
hero.note: In Arabic and English · No account needed to try · Nothing is shared without your permission

simulator.gridLabel: Punnett square: two carrier parents (Aa × Aa)

conditions.title: One place for any inherited condition
conditions.body: Whatever your screening finds, GeneBridge explains it: blood, neuromuscular, hearing, metabolic and many more, across recessive, dominant and X-linked inheritance.
conditions.more: + every condition in your screening panel

add.title: Add your results
add.body: Enter your screening reference, scan the QR code, or simply photograph your report. Securely.

understand.title: Understand your risk
understand.body: A clear, plain-language explanation of inherited risks, for you and, if you both agree, as a couple.

support.title: Get expert support
support.body: Explore every option and connect with a qualified genetic counsellor in your language.

showcase.title: Tools that do the hard part with you.

scan.title: Photograph your report. Get every finding explained.
scan.body: Take a photo or upload your screening report. GeneBridge reads it, you check what it found, and each finding is explained in plain words you can also listen to. Uncertain findings go straight to a counsellor.
scan.promise: Photos are deleted as soon as they're read

family.title: Say who's in your family. Watch the tree draw itself.
family.body: Speak or type in Arabic or English, the way you'd tell a friend. GeneBridge proposes the people and how they're related, asks when something is unclear, and saves nothing until you keep it.
family.promise: Names are removed before anything reaches the AI

assistant.title: Ask about inheritance. Hear the answer.
assistant.body: Type or speak your question. Ask GeneBridge answers in short, everyday words from a reviewed library, reads the reply aloud with captions, and offers a counsellor when a question needs a person.
assistant.promise: It never diagnoses, and uses your result only if you turn that on

scene.question: Does being a carrier mean I'm ill?
scene.answer: No. Carriers are healthy. It only matters when planning children, and only if your partner carries a change in the same gene.

nearby.title: Find verified care close to you.
nearby.body: Search for a place, or share your location once, to see verified professionals and services nearby, with their languages, next free time and directions.
nearby.promise: Your location is rounded on your device and never stored

showcase.subtitle: Check for a shared change without showing each other your results, photograph a report, describe your family out loud, ask a question and hear the answer, or find care close by. In Arabic and English.

blindMatch.title: Find out if you share a change, without showing your results.
blindMatch.body: One of you shows a code, the other scans it, and each agrees on your own phone. You both see one answer: whether you carry a change in the same gene. Neither of you sees the other’s result, and a shared change comes with a direct route to a genetic counsellor.
blindMatch.promise: Results are compared privately, never shown to the other person

scene.neither: Neither of you saw the other’s result

features.title: More than a test result. A complete genetic decision platform.

results.title: Genetic Risk Analysis
results.body: Understand every finding in your screening, for any inherited condition, in plain language.

couple.title: Couple Compatibility
couple.body: See your shared chances for future children, only when you both agree.

simulator.title: Inheritance Simulator
simulator.body: Visualise how gene copies pass from parents to a child, one pregnancy at a time.

family.title: Family History Mapping
family.body: Say or type who's in your family, and a private tree draws itself.

counsellor.title: Counsellor & Referral
counsellor.body: Message and book verified genetic counsellors, meet by video, and track every step of your care.

privacy.title: Privacy & Consent
privacy.body: You control your data, what to share, and who can see it.

privacy.title: Your result is yours.
privacy.point1: Nothing is shared without your permission, not even with your partner
privacy.point2: Change or withdraw consent at any time
privacy.point3: We store your result interpretation, never your raw genome
privacy.point4: Tell relatives about a family risk without revealing your own result
privacy.point5: Report photos are deleted as soon as they're read, and names are removed before anything reaches the AI

pros.title: Patients arrive informed. You see what they choose to share.
pros.point1: Only verified professionals: a person checks every licence before you see a patient
pros.point2: A short brief before each session, drawn only from what the patient chose to share
pros.point3: After the session, a plain-language summary drafted from your notes. Nothing reaches the patient until you edit and approve it
pros.point4: Complex or uncertain findings are routed to you, never explained by the app
pros.point5: Messages, bookings and video sessions in one workspace, with referral tracking

conditions.a: Any inherited condition in your screening panel, from blood conditions like the thalassemias and sickle cell disease to SMA, cystic fibrosis, hearing loss, metabolic conditions and more. Recessive, dominant and X-linked inheritance are all explained.

guest.q: Do I need an account to try it?
guest.a: No. You can continue as a guest and start exploring straight away. Your guest session stays on this device until you sign out.

carrier.q: Does a carrier result mean I'm sick?
carrier.a: No. Carriers are healthy. Being a carrier only matters when planning children, and only if your partner carries a change in the same gene. For dominant and X-linked conditions things work differently, and a counsellor will explain.

sharing.q: Will my partner or family see my result?
sharing.a: Only if you choose. Your partner sees a couple view only when you both agree, and you can tell relatives about a family risk without revealing your own result.

blindMatch.q: Can we check for a shared risk without showing each other our results?
blindMatch.a: Yes, with Blind Match. You each agree on your own phone, and you both see one answer: whether you carry a change in the same gene. Neither of you sees the other’s result. It covers only the conditions you were both screened for, it isn’t advice about marriage, and a genetic counsellor can explain what a shared change means.

marriage.q: Will GeneBridge tell us whether to marry?
marriage.a: No. GeneBridge gives information and support, never a recommendation. Every option is shown equally and the decision is always yours.

ai.q: Does the AI assistant interpret my result?
ai.a: Only if you ask it to. It answers general questions about genetics, and explains your own result only when you turn on “Use my result in this chat”. It never diagnoses or works out risk itself: every number comes from the same inheritance engine as the rest of GeneBridge. Anything uncertain or complex goes to a qualified counsellor.
